title: White House announces Gaza ‘board of peace’ with Tony Blair, Jared Kushner and Marco Rubio
summary: Body chaired by Trump tasked with overseeing reconstruction of Gaza and transitional administration The White House has released a list of officials appointed by Donald Trump to what he’s calling a “board of peace”, tasked with overseeing the reconstruction of Gaza, and its transitional administration. The names included US secretary of state Marco Rubio, former British prime minister Tony Blair, Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner and Trump special envoy Steve Witkoff, the White House said.
